## How to use this sheet

For every presenter, write one brief note that shows what you learned, noticed, connected with, questioned, or wanted to comment on. Then rate your own attention honestly:

- **A** = Attentive
- **S** = Some lapses
- **N** = Not attentive

Phones should be away unless directed otherwise. Face the speaker, avoid side conversations, and make space for the person presenting. An honest **S** or **N** is better than a false **A**. Knowingly inaccurate self-ratings can reduce the **Integrity & Reflection** score more than the original lapse would have.

On the back, complete the listening self-evaluation using evidence from what you actually did. Then complete the Learning Skills self-check and explain one strength and one next step.

## Listening self-evaluation - use evidence

Score each area using the **The Way We Meet** rubric. Give brief evidence of what you actually did. If the area was not strong, write what you should do differently next time.

| Listening area | What I should evaluate | My score | My evidence or next step |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| Attention & Presence | Phone away, face the speaker, avoid side conversations, refocus after distractions | ___ /2 | ______________________________ |
| Audience Notes | A specific listening note for each presenter | ___ /2 | ______________________________ |
| Discussion & Connections | Questions, comments, or connections that help the conversation | ___ /2 | ______________________________ |
| Completion & Consistency | Kept the sheet up to date across both days with few or no gaps | ___ /2 | ______________________________ |
| Integrity & Reflection | Honest A/S/N ratings and awareness of lapses | ___ /2 | ______________________________ |
| **Total** |  | **___ /10** | |

## Learning Skills self-check

Circle **C = Consistently**, **S = Sometimes**, or **N = Not yet** for each skill.

| Learning Skill | C / S / N | What it looked like during this activity |
|---|:---:|---|
| Responsibility | C / S / N | Prepared, phone away, completed and submitted the work |
| Organization | C / S / N | Notes complete, readable, and in order |
| Independent Work | C / S / N | Worked without repeated reminders |
| Collaboration | C / S / N | Was a respectful audience member and supported speakers |
| Initiative | C / S / N | Offered a thoughtful question, comment, or connection |
| Self-Regulation | C / S / N | Managed distractions and refocused after a lapse |
